# CookYourYum

> > A comprehensive international recipe collection featuring authentic traditional cuisine from 18+ global cuisines with cooking inspiration and culinary guidance.

CookYourYum is a recipe-focused website showcasing traditional dishes and cooking techniques from cuisines around the world, including Asian, European, Middle Eastern, African, and Latin American culinary traditions. The site serves as a resource for home cooks seeking authentic international recipes and regional specialty dishes.

## Key Topics

- International cuisine
- Traditional recipes
- Asian cuisine
- Seafood recipes
- Lamb recipes
- Vegetarian recipes
- Comfort food
- Regional cuisine
- Authentic recipes
- Cooking inspiration
- French cuisine
- Korean cuisine
- Ethiopian cuisine
- Recipe collection
- Desserts

## Global Cuisine Guides

- [Brazilian Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/brazilian): Brazilian cuisine recipes including beef dishes and traditional comfort food
- [Chinese Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/chinese): Chinese recipes featuring Peking Duck, dumplings, and traditional Asian dishes
- [Ethiopian Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/ethiopian): Ethiopian traditional dishes including Gomen Alicha and spicy vegetarian recipes
- [French Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/french): French cuisine with Ratatouille, Boeuf Bourguignon, and classic sauces
- [Greek Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/greek): Greek traditional dishes featuring lamb, seafood, and Mediterranean cuisine
- [Indian Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/indian): Indian regional cuisine with Kashmiri Pulao and vegetarian dishes
- [Italian Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/italian): Italian recipes featuring pasta, polenta, and traditional regional cooking
- [Japanese Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/japanese): Japanese cuisine with Soba, Tsukune, and traditional home cooking recipes
- [Korean Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/korean): Korean recipes including Aged Kimchi, seafood, and traditional side dishes
- [Lebanese Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/lebanese): Lebanese Middle Eastern cuisine with meat and vegetarian traditional dishes
- [Mexican Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/mexican): Mexican traditional cuisine featuring Cochinita Pibil and authentic recipes
- [Moroccan Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/moroccan): Moroccan recipes with Couscous, Tagine, and spiced lamb dishes
- [Peruvian Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/peruvian): Peruvian traditional cuisine with seafood and regional specialty dishes
- [Spanish Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/spanish): Spanish recipes featuring lamb, seafood, stews, and regional cuisine
- [Thai Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/thai): Thai cuisine with traditional dishes and Asian cooking recipes
- [Turkish Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/turkish): Turkish recipes featuring Doner Kebab, pilaf, and Middle Eastern comfort food
- [Vietnamese Recipes](https://cookyouryum.com/recipes/vietnamese): Vietnamese traditional dishes with noodle soups, desserts, and street food
